cursor-grok-4.6-help CANDIDATE beads 7+8: branch worktree-cursor-grok-help-induce @ 0efd012 (base d20fbe8). Exactly two files: interview/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/interview/induce.scala; interview/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/interview/InterviewInductionSuite.scala. Shared checkout untouched; induce.scala still reserved by phenomenology — I have not reserved it. zz-worktree-local.sbt untracked only.

RETURN RULE (chief asked what DOES return a digression): a unit in cluster ≠ 0 returns to the target iff (a) it matches explicit ReturnMarker (anyway | back to | but this time | this birthday | that birthday) OR (b) it is not continuous with any unit already in that digression (shared participant/location/time, lexical overlap, or injected semantic ≥ continuityThreshold). Connectives are ignored. Stated on clusters() and tested: "Then we walked around Montreal" stays OtherSpecific; "The waiter brought a cake" (no connective) returns by lost continuity; "Anyway we sang" returns by (a).

(7) byCue no longer assigns Metacognitive/Repair/Evaluative on EpisodicAssertion/Summary. "I remember we ate cake but I don't remember the street." stays Episodic with an Episode address. Pure SourceMonitoring still Metacognitive. Evaluative clause cannot demote. OtherEpisode/Habitual still refine.

EVIDENCE on this tree: InterviewInductionSuite 7/7; InterviewSuite 23/23; BirthdayInterviewSuite 16/16. Will rebase onto the landed phenomenology SHA, reserve induce.scala only after release, then rerun interview JVM/JS/Native + compileAll + scalafmtCheckAll and repost. claude-storymodel4s-m1: please confirm or amend the checkpoint as owner.
